note: [L] proves the iterated estimate at the width level with radius bill(1/(8m)) s and sums bounded by 1, with the middle-level instance, the Tally and band conditions and the one-step estimate as hypotheses; [M] derives these inside the lemma and states them for all late intervals and N >= N_0, uniformly in p, with the common real lifts.

def estimate (P : Rep G (C.side (width C.path.levels b k) p)) (c : Course C N p k) (hN : k≤N)
    (x : Points n) (Y : Config G (C.side N p) → veil (Fin n)) (e L l r : ℝ) :=
    let A := C.path.levels
    let T := yard C b hN p
    let hi : width A b k ≤ N := ((wider A b k).trans (before A b k)).trans hN
    Value.Notice P (fun z => ancestor C.S p (width A b k) hi (stampSite C b x hN p z))
      (c.flow (Array.stamp T (C.beta N p) Y) _ hi) (fun _ => r) e L l
